_doc: Stream E (M2). Quests for zone 'gorse_march' (The Gorse March). Format: data/quests/README.md. Rewards: xp = share of a level's XP at the quest level, gold = multiple of a kill's gold; item.tier rolls at your level. `killRare` {zone, slot} names the zone's rare by slot (data/provinces/rares.json). Story-chain quests carry `story: n` (data/quests/province.json).

redoubt_captain.name: Captain Hollis Gorse
redoubt_captain.greeting: The redoubt holds the march. The gorse holds everything else, prickly.

barn_widow.name: Widow Edda
barn_widow.greeting: They burned the barns. I'm still here. They should be worried.

march_trader.name: Garrick the pedlar
march_trader.greeting: Pins, needles, arrowheads. All pointy. It's that sort of country.

quests.name: Burnt Barns
quests.offer: Raiders burned the barns and left their pets behind. Fire imps in my hay. Get them out.
quests.done: The hay's safe. What's left of it.

quests.name: Laughter in the Gorse
quests.offer: Hyenas den in the gorse and laugh at my patrols. My patrols have feelings.
quests.done: No more laughing. My patrols are much happier.

quests.name: Pointy Business
quests.offer: Raiders robbed my arrowhead shipment and are using it on me. That's double rude.
quests.done: Back in stock! Arrowheads, half price, slightly used.

quests.name: Relief for the Redoubt
quests.offer: Raiders keep probing the redoubt. Push back their camps before they find the soft spot. There's always a soft spot.

quests.name: The March Tower
quests.offer: The raiders have taken the watchtower on the hill. All the way up. Take it back, floor by floor.
quests.done: Our flag flies on the hill. The gorse looks almost friendly.

quests.name: The March's Worst
quests.offer: There's a beast out on the march that the raiders feed. Kill it and they'll go hungry.
